snippet.title: Gothic 1 Remake | Making Of #05: Bringing the World to Life
snippet.description:
"Our main inspiration was obviously the visuals of the old one. Because there was a lot of fine detail in there, although it was just 512 by 512 or even lower."

Join the team at Alkimia Interactive for an in-depth look at how the world, characters, and systems of Gothic 1 Remake are being reimagined. From art direction and character creation to armor customization and cinematic storytelling, this dev diary dives deep into the care, challenges, and passion behind reviving a cult RPG classic.
